2. Run orphan-file removal on those same tables with the same cutoff, so the data files behind the expired snapshots are actually deleted.

Expiring snapshots removes the ability to roll back to those older versions. That's why I'd keep the cutoff conservative. If you want me to continue, or want a different retention window, tell me and I'll pick it up when the tool limit resets.
